svg.title: Unburden Root
svg.desc: Unburden Root, a multi-agent harness, in daily use and private. An animated diagram: Claude Code sessions working as named roles (an orchestrator, reviewers and stage sessions) load the shared memory and written rules; tasks leave the sessions, pass a PII guard and reach a router that sends each one to a model pool by cost and urgency. The task carrying personal data is refused at the guard, which fails closed; the guard has its own test cases.
